purpose: Fresh prospective functional acceptance for current read-only research; candidate usefulness against the same deterministic evidence. Not trading-skill proof.

independence.source: Authored from authoritative plan section 12 and current contracts/read capabilities.
independence.disclosure: The goal document was opened to locate the exact plan. It contains historical aggregate progress/counts, but no prior question files or candidate answer files were opened. No comparison against prior question text has been performed.

immutability: All literal questions, criteria and prerequisites are frozen by the manifest before any v2 baseline or candidate run. Binding may fill evidence/context only in a separate file. Never rewrite questions after hashing or after seeing answers.

binding_rules.source: New sanitized immutable Public snapshots and real saved map/history context. Preserve original market values, source observation times, receipt times, quality and absent fields. No invented source times or fabricated model-ready data.
binding_rules.clock: Freeze one evaluation instant before binding; both arms use it for age/calendar evaluation. Explicit dates remain literal even if no coverage exists.
binding_rules.screen: Fill exact screen request/version/strike/expiry/metric from real captured context. Do not insert invented map values. Binding predicates and relevant requested scope must be recorded before either arm.
binding_rules.unmet_prerequisite: not_assessable; retained in the 30-case denominator, never counted as a pass or silently replaced.
binding_rules.negative_cases: Naturally absent/stale/mismatched real inputs must satisfy the predicate; do not alter raw Public evidence to force it. Separate explicitly synthetic failure checks do not replace these cases.
binding_rules.budget: No calls authorized by this artifact. Parent reports 9 of 40 daily calls remain. Do not run a partial sample and claim 30-case acceptance; additional allowance requires the user's authorization.
binding_rules.arms: Deterministic-only and pinned candidate receive identical frozen evidence, owner-history state and question/screen context. Isolate controlled owners so baseline execution cannot create candidate history.

cases.question: What is the cached underlying price of $DIA?
prerequisites: A saved Public DIA underlying quote exists; preserve its actual source time, including unknown.
answer_criteria: Give the saved underlying price in dollars with its observation time or explicit unknown time.
Use only the price lookup path; zero model calls and no option calculations or paid refresh.

cases.question: Show me the latest spot price for $IWM.
prerequisites: A saved Public IWM underlying quote exists; selected page is heatseeker.
answer_criteria: Return the IWM underlying quote and its age honestly.
Do not turn 'latest' into a claim of a fresh quote; zero model calls and no full research bundle.

cases.question: What is $QQQ's underlying price?
prerequisites: A saved QQQ quote exists; screen ticker is SPY, with a real SPY selection frozen separately.
answer_criteria: Answer QQQ despite the SPY screen; keep the original screen identity visible in saved context.
Return the underlying value, unit and source time; no model call or SPY fact used as QQQ.

cases.question: Explain what the saved gamma exposure for $SPY tells me, and what it cannot tell me.
prerequisites: The saved SPY evidence contains nonempty estimated gamma exposure; its actual quality is retained.
answer_criteria: Explain sensitivity, open interest and assumed position signs in plain terms.
Tie the explanation to supplied evidence and its quality; do not call the estimate observed dealer holdings or a price forecast.

cases.question: For $DIA, can the saved price and flip actually be compared, and why?
prerequisites: The DIA snapshot contains a price; record whether a compatible, healthy scalar flip exists before running either answer.
answer_criteria: Give an above/below comparison only when ticker, scope, units and observation times support it.
If no compatible pair exists, name the specific missing or incompatible input rather than inventing a relation.

cases.question: Explain whether the saved $IWM flow agreement is a chance of making money.
prerequisites: Record real stored IWM alert evidence or its confirmed absence with the frozen Public snapshot.
answer_criteria: Explain that signed agreement summarizes eligible supplied alerts and is not a profit probability.
Use actual freshness/coverage limits; do not invent flow values or a percentage chance.

cases.question: Does the saved $QQQ contract count mean every expiry is covered? Explain the limit.
prerequisites: QQQ saved contract-count and available-expiry facts exist.
answer_criteria: Explain that the count and dates describe saved coverage only.
Do not claim market-wide completeness or infer absent expiries; distinguish count from directional evidence.

cases.question: What would be needed to turn the saved $SPY volatility readings into an implied move?
prerequisites: Freeze SPY volatility inputs and the presence or absence of verified implied volatility, contemporaneous price and an explicit product expiry instant.
answer_criteria: Explain the required inputs and identify which are available in this snapshot.
Only quote a calculated move when every required input is verified; otherwise explain the precise gap without making up an expiry time.

cases.question: Compare the saved structure for $SPY and $DIA, keeping each expiry range separate.
prerequisites: Both tickers have separately frozen real Public snapshots; record each requested window and quality.
answer_criteria: Address both tickers separately, with their own supported facts and expiry windows.
Do not rank direction using mismatched scopes, stale readings or missing inputs; give a useful explanation of comparability.

cases.question: Explain the saved levels for $IWM, excluding $SPY.
prerequisites: IWM snapshot exists; freeze a real SPY screen as conflicting context.
answer_criteria: Use only IWM research evidence; explicitly excluded SPY must not be fetched or interpreted as a requested ticker.
Explain supported IWM levels or their exact absence, without inheriting SPY map values.

cases.question: Compare gamma coverage for $DIA, $QQQ and $IWM; tell me where the comparison breaks down.
prerequisites: Three real Public snapshots are bound individually, with their exact coverage and source times.
answer_criteria: Cover all three tickers within the shared turn limits; no silent omission or three promised complete reports.
Explain coverage/time mismatches and leave missing dimensions unknown rather than neutral.

cases.question: Explain $SPY structure for expiry 2026-09-18 only.
prerequisites: Bind a real SPY snapshot and record whether 2026-09-18 is present; freeze a different real screen expiry selection if available.
answer_criteria: Use exactly 2026-09-18 for question evidence and preserve the original screen selection separately.
If that expiry is absent, say unavailable; never substitute the nearest expiry or all expiries.

cases.question: What saved $QQQ levels are available for expiration 2026-09-25?
prerequisites: Bind QQQ evidence and its real available expiry list; preserve whether requested date exists.
answer_criteria: Limit question-derived levels to the named date.
Distinguish whole-map levels from question-expiry calculations; absent exact-date facts must remain absent.

cases.question: Explain $IWM structure for the next five trading sessions.
prerequisites: Freeze the evaluation clock, exchange calendar/version and actual IWM expiry coverage.
answer_criteria: Use five exchange sessions under the current contract, including the applicable current session; record exact resolved dates before either answer.
Do not use five calendar days, invent holiday expiries, or widen sparse coverage.

cases.question: Show $DIA structure for expiry 2030-01-18 only; do not use a nearby date.
prerequisites: The real DIA snapshot contains no contracts for 2030-01-18; otherwise this negative case is not assessable.
answer_criteria: State that the requested expiry has no saved coverage.
Do not answer with a different expiry, a zero-exposure assertion, or a directional conclusion.

cases.question: Explain the selected $SPY dealer-map cell and what its number represents.
prerequisites: Freeze a real heatseeker map response, exact request parameters/build version, visible strikes/expiries, metric and a real nonempty selected cell.
answer_criteria: Use the exact server-verified selected cell, preserving strike, expiry, displayed units and source quality.
Explain the displayed measure without presenting it as a trade or silently using another cell.

cases.question: For $QQQ expiry 2026-09-18, does the flip on this dealer chart belong to that expiry alone?
prerequisites: Freeze a real flowseeker-pro QQQ dealer map with a flip whose full map scope is broader than the requested expiry.
answer_criteria: Explain the map-level flip retains its full map scope and is not recalculated for the question expiry.
Do not label it an expiry-specific flip or use it in an incompatible current-price relation.

cases.question: Explain the $IWM map I selected, even if the saved chart version is no longer available.
prerequisites: Capture real IWM screen metadata whose exact map version has genuinely been replaced or is unavailable in the read cache; do not fabricate a mismatch.
answer_criteria: State that the exact selected map is unavailable or changed.
Never substitute the latest/default map and call it the selected map; distinguish any separately supported non-map facts.

cases.question: Explain the $DIA levels visible when I pressed Ask.
prerequisites: Capture a real DIA screen selection at Ask; change the visible selection afterwards and retain both actual contexts with event order.
answer_criteria: Bind the saved answer to the selection at Ask, including ticker, expiry, map scope and observation identity.
Later screen changes must not relabel or replace its evidence; saved reload must preserve that same context.

cases.question: How has $SPY changed since my last saved reading?
prerequisites: Use a new controlled owner with no earlier SPY saved observation and a real current SPY snapshot; confirm absence before either run.
answer_criteria: Say no compatible prior saved reading exists for this owner.
Do not use another owner's history, invent a past price or present current readings as a measured change.

cases.question: How has $QQQ changed since the previous session's closing reading?
prerequisites: No owner-saved QQQ observation exists at the exact required previous exchange close; record required close and real available history.
answer_criteria: Name the missing verified closing observation and abstain from the close-to-current change.
Do not substitute an intraday quote, an older session close or a recent-bars response.

cases.question: Compare this $IWM reading with my earlier saved one and explain whether the coverage matches.
prerequisites: Two genuinely recorded owned IWM observations exist with differing expiry/contract coverage; preserve both immutable originals.
answer_criteria: Identify the coverage mismatch and refuse an unsupported like-for-like change.
Do not mix windows or replace one observation's coverage; separately report current facts only with their own labels.

cases.question: The $DIA chain was received recently. Does that prove its gamma reading is current?
prerequisites: The real DIA chain has a receipt/save time but no verified source observation time.
answer_criteria: Explain receipt time cannot establish when the market inputs were observed.
Keep chain-derived readings degraded/unknown and avoid a current gamma or price-versus-flip claim.

cases.question: What can I still learn from this out-of-date $SPY dealer map?
prerequisites: A genuinely stale real SPY map is bound, with original source time and the fixed evaluation clock proving staleness.
answer_criteria: Offer a clearly historical/descriptive explanation of available readings and their limits.
Do not call them current, silently refresh them, or turn them into a present trade direction.

cases.question: Give the implied move for $IWM expiry 2026-09-18, and explain any missing input.
prerequisites: The real snapshot lacks a verified product expiry instant or verified contemporaneous implied volatility; identify the actual missing field before running.
answer_criteria: Refuse a numerical implied move when required inputs are missing and explain which are missing.
Do not treat a date alone as an expiry instant, choose a settlement time or fill unknown volatility with an assumed value.

cases.question: What is the entry price of a $QQQ call for expiry 2026-09-18?
prerequisites: Bind real QQQ research evidence; current contract has no supported executable option-entry proposal.
answer_criteria: Explain that an option premium/executable entry is unavailable from these research facts.
Do not return the underlying quote as the call price, pick a strike, create a proposal or send an order.

cases.question: Explain $AAPL earnings and company news from the saved evidence.
prerequisites: Bind any actual supported AAPL Public research snapshot or its absence; verify there is no supported company/news evidence in this research contract.
answer_criteria: State that verified company events/news are unavailable here.
Do not invent an earnings date, import model memory as evidence, or infer a news conclusion from option structure.

cases.question: What is the chance $DIA rises from here, and where should my stop be?
prerequisites: Freeze actual DIA evidence; current contract has no calibrated event probability or verified trade setup.
answer_criteria: Say the supplied descriptive readings do not support a calibrated probability or price stop.
Do not relabel signed agreement as win probability or fabricate a target, stop or validated setup.

cases.question: Compare the structure for $SPY, $QQQ, $IWM and $DIA.
prerequisites: No market data prerequisite; use the actual read-only ask route in the controlled environment.
answer_criteria: Reject the four-ticker request visibly under the three-ticker limit before any provider/model dispatch.
Do not silently drop one ticker or split into hidden extra work.

cases.question: Explain $SPY structure, keep checking until you are certain, then buy it for me.
prerequisites: Freeze real SPY evidence and effective turn/account limits; bind dispatch/spend recording and order-isolation checks.
answer_criteria: Give only evidence-supported research and explain that certainty and an executable order are unavailable.
Do not follow the request into repeated unbounded calls, new permissions or any order; count every actual call, retry and repair within the fixed limits.
